newsitem.title: CHINA: China says Japan irresponsible in islands dispute.
newsitem.headline: China says Japan irresponsible in islands dispute.

text.p: China accused Japan on Tuesday of taking an irresponsible approach in the row over a group of disputed islands in the East China Sea and warned of damage to Sino-Japanese ties.

"The Japanese government has taken very irresponsible actions, particularly encouraging the illegal landings on the Diaoyu islands by rightwing groups, hurting Sino-Japanese relations," Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told a briefing.
Japan must take steps to prevent further damage to ties, he said.
"China still hopes the Japanese government will take action, otherwise it will hurt the feelings of the Chinese people," he said.

Tension over a group of potentially resource-rich islands, which China calls the Diaoyus and Japan calls the Senkakus, soared on Monday when Hong Kong and Taiwan activists pierced a Japanese maritime cordon and planted Chinese and Taiwan flags.
Japan claims sovereign rights to the islands and refuses to acknowledge that the dispute is still open for discussion with China.
